description.value: Boulder Hill Baking is a mother-daughter-run artisan bakery in Cumberland that started as a wholesale operation in 2019 and opened its storefront in 2025. The shop offers a rotating daily selection of handmade cakes, pies, scones, cookies, breads, and more, drawing on local ingredients including dairy from Natural Pastures Cheeses and fruit from Comox Valley farms. Cumberland is a popular cycling destination, and this bakery sits right in the village core.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM record: address (2694 Dunsmuir Avenue, Cumberland), phone (250-400-0560), and website URL all match. The site confirms the business is a real, open storefront bakery that expanded from wholesale in 2025, selling a rotating selection of baked goods. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those fields are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible artisan bakery in a well-known cycling village; a useful food stop for touring cyclists.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM shop=bakery was matched to Groceries; this is a dedicated artisan bakery rather than a general grocery store, but baked goods (breads, pastries, etc.) make it a legitimate food-stop for cyclists.
